title: T12b companion: authenticate the Rig to the local service
head: codex/t12b-rig-auth
body:
## What
The narrow desktop companion to the agent-core T12b service (decision #39). Endpoint paths and JSON payloads are unchanged.
- **Native token read:** `get_service_token` (`src-tauri/src/lib.rs`) reads keychain service `OASIS`, account `rig.service_token` through the `keyring` crate (Windows/macOS targets, matching CI). Any failure collapses to one generic message. The keychain's own error and the token are never logged or returned.
- **HTTP:** `serviceClient.ts` adds `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to every request.
- **WebSocket:** `new WebSocket(url, ["bearer", token])`. The service validates the second value and echoes `bearer`.
- The token never appears in a URL, log, error or fixture. The employee never enters anything.
- `docs/local-api.md` documents the auth addition.

## Behavior to review
- A missing keychain value is **not** a new UI state. The request goes out without a token, the service rejects it, and screens show their existing "not reachable yet" state. Say if you want a distinct "sign-in token missing" message.
- `tests/fakeService.ts` enforces auth only when a test opts in (`requireToken`). `Chat.test.tsx` and the new `serviceClientAuth.test.ts` opt in; the other screen tests are untouched.

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)
- `npm test` → 8 files, 29 tests passed
- `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` → exit 0
- `cargo fmt --check` → clean; `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -D warnings` → clean
- `cargo test --locked` → 17 passed (keychain tests use `keyring::mock` and `sk-FAKE-0000`, never the real keychain)
- `npm run tauri build -- --no-bundle` → release binary built (macOS)
- `git diff --check` → clean

## Pending
Real keychain and Windows acceptance need Braden's machine. Pairs with the agent-core T12b service PR (opening next).
